newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Uralsvyazinform 96 net up to 148 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russian Uralsvyazinform 96 net up to 148 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTE - Figures are on accrual basis. On February 4 the company said pre-tax profit was 139.5 billion roubles and net profit 104.7 billion, but these were on cash basis.
Uralsvyazinform is based in Perm in Urals.
Its shares are traded on the Russian Trading System-2, an electronic trade system dedicated to less liquid stock. The share closed at $0.0503 on Friday.

In January Uralsvyazinvform raised $3.5 million by selling about one percent of its shares to foreign investors through Williams de Broe. These shares have not been listed on a foreign stock exchange. The company is planning an American Depositary Receipt (ADR) issue at the end of March.
